_about: Margin thresholds for the map colour steps, as fractions of all votes. A place at or above thresholds[i] (but below the next) gets step i+1; below the first it is a toss-up. Loaded by marginBins.ts; colours per step are in styles/tokens.css (--map-d1..5, --map-r1..5). labels[0] is the toss-up band, then one label per step.
